implementationNotes: Prefer the six artist campaign illustrations on their matching song cards.
Use object-position 50% 75% for the yacht so the subject survives square cropping.
The four square initial teasers downloaded are 960x960, sufficient for compact cards but not full-screen HD; original archive metadata lists 1440x1440.
Yacht and iguana downloads are 1920x2400; Justice composer illustration 1920x1080; Flower single cover 1440x1440.
Keep sources in the site credits or source drawer. Artwork captions can be compact and accurate.
Do not convert the live-action Fuerza teaser or Cardi hoodie Story into invented illustration.
